title: 第17章 和秋霜姐的“唇枪舌战”
novel_title: 神医小傻驴的乡村女人
content_zh:
李秋霜感受着李大壮宽广结实的怀抱，只觉得安全感满满，一想到即将发生的事，期待的同时也难免紧张，香软的娇躯，忍不住在李大壮怀里微微发抖。

    “姐，别紧张，等会我会很温柔的。”

    李大壮单手抱着李秋霜，腾出另一只手，沿着玲珑的曲线轻轻安抚，滚烫的手掌在李秋霜身子上惹出阵阵涟漪，反倒惹的她颤栗的更狠了……

    贴在李大壮耳边的红唇，也发出阵阵娇喘：“臭小子，别~别弄了，姐受不了……”

    “这才哪到哪，姐就受不了了，等会真打起来了，那才刺激呢……”

    “大壮你……你学坏了~~”

    娇喘间，李大壮已经抱着李秋霜走进自己房间，这是他恢复神智后，第一次回自己屋。

    借着窗外的月光，李大壮扫了一眼破旧的小屋，墙边放着一张年头久远的旧板床，床边有张断了腿，用砖头勉强支撑的破方桌，床尾立着个掉了漆的老式衣柜，这就是屋里所有的家当了。

    原本已经“火冒三丈”的李大壮，忽然就冷静了几分。

    现在家里实在太穷了，今天晚上庆祝的饭，还是用父亲的赔偿款买的，自己现在的首要任务是赚钱，快点让父母姐姐过上好日子！

    而且这屋子虽破旧，却被秋霜姐收拾的整洁干净，这么好的女人，自己真的要对她做禽兽之事吗？

    万一以后惹她伤心掉了眼泪，自己不得心疼坏了！

    “大壮，你咋不动了？先把我放床上呀~~”李秋霜不知李大壮心中所想，红着脸娇羞催促。

    李大壮抱着李秋霜坐在床边，破床嘎吱一声，仿佛随时要塌。

    “姐，你想好了？真给我?”李大壮声音低沉喑哑，心情复杂。

    李秋霜虽然害羞，但一双水眸中透着坚定的光：“姐说了，姐早就想给你了！”

    “要是以后，我做出让你伤心的事呢？”李大壮试探着说。

    “啥伤心的事？”李秋霜不明所以，却又忽然想到什么似的，俏丽媚人的脸蛋儿忽然严肃起来：“大壮！你不会还惦记着大学里那个女人吧！？”

    李秋霜说的，是当初给李大壮戴了绿帽子，还眼睁睁看着李大壮被打傻的那个女人！
content_en:
Li Qiu Shuang felt Li Dazhuang's broad and strong embrace and felt full of security. Thinking of what was about to happen, she was unavoidably nervous while looking forward to it. Her soft and delicate body could not help but tremble slightly in Li Dazhuang's arms.

    "Sister, don't be nervous, I will be very gentle later."

    Li Dazhuang held Li Qiu Shuang with one hand and freed up his other hand to gently comfort her along the exquisite curves. His hot palm caused ripples on Li Qiu Shuang's body, which made her tremble even more...

    The red lips next to Li Dazhuang's ear also let out gasps: "Smelly boy, stop~ stop doing it, I can't stand it..."

    "What's going on right now? Sister can't stand it anymore. It will be exciting if we really start fighting later..."

    “大壮你……你学坏了~~”

    娇喘间，李大壮已经抱着李秋霜走进自己房间，这是他恢复神智后，第一次回自己屋。

    By the moonlight outside the window, Li Dazhuang glanced at the dilapidated cabin. There was an old plank bed beside the wall. Beside the bed was a broken square table with broken legs and barely supported by bricks. At the end of the bed stood an old-fashioned wardrobe with peeling paint. These were all the belongings in the house.

    Li Dazhuang, who was already furious, suddenly calmed down a bit.

    Now my family is really poor. The meal for tonight's celebration was bought with my father's compensation money. My first priority now is to make money and let my parents and sisters live a good life as soon as possible!

    Moreover, although this house is dilapidated, it has been kept neat and tidy by Sister Qiu Shuang. Do you really want to treat such a good woman like a beast?

    If she makes her sad and sheds tears in the future, I will be heartbroken!

    "Dazhuang, why don't you move? Put me on the bed first~" Li Qiu Shuang didn't know what Li Dazhuang was thinking, so she urged him with a blushing face.

    Li Dazhuang held Li Qiu Shuang and sat on the edge of the bed. The broken bed creaked as if it was about to collapse at any moment.

    "Sister, have you thought about it? Give it to me?" Li Dazhuang's voice was low and hoarse, and his mood was complicated.

    李秋霜虽然害羞，但一双水眸中透着坚定的光：“姐说了，姐早就想给你了！”

    "What if I do something that makes you sad in the future?" Li Dazhuang asked tentatively.

    "What's the sad thing?" Li Qiu Shuang didn't know why, but as if something suddenly occurred to him, his pretty and charming face suddenly became serious: "Da Zhuang! You're not still thinking about that woman in college, are you!?"

    Li Qiu Shuang was talking about the woman who cuckolded Li Dazhuang and watched Li Dazhuang being beaten stupidly!
